page.title: Publish and send

state.DRAFT: Draft: guests can’t open it yet
state.PUBLISHED: Published: guests can open their links and reply
state.CLOSED: Replies stopped: guests can still open it, but can’t reply

page.noInvitation: This event has no invitation yet.

status.closed: Replies are stopped. Guests can still open the invitation.

publish.title: Publish
publish.lead: Publishing makes the invitation live: guests can open their links, and you can send it.
publish.ready: Nothing stands in the way of publishing.
publish.blockersRefused: What still blocks publishing isn’t shown to your role. Publishing will say if anything does.
publish.waiting: Publishing waits for the items above.
publish.confirmBody: Guests will be able to open their links from now on, and you can send the invitation.
publish.noWayBack: Once published, it can’t go back to being a draft. You can stop replies at any time, and take them again.

blockers.rsvp: The reply section is switched off in the invitation’s design, so guests would have no way to answer. It can’t be switched on here yet.
blockers.venue: Add a venue with an address, so guests know where to go.
blockers.started: The event has already started, so an invitation would arrive late. If its date is wrong, correct it.
blockers.inEnglish: Some of these are in English for now.

replies.title: Replies
replies.open: Guests can reply. Stopping replies keeps the invitation readable, since the venue, the time and the dress code still matter to everyone coming. You can take replies again later.
replies.closed: Replies are stopped. Guests can still open the invitation. Taking replies again lets them answer, and lets you send it.

send.title: Send the invitation
send.lead: Each household gets one message with its own link, by email, or on Telegram if they use it. Sending again is safe: a household already invited isn’t sent another, and one whose message failed is tried again.
send.everyone: Send to every household not yet invited
send.closed: Replies are stopped, so the invitation can’t be sent. Take replies again to send it.

summary.seeEach: See each household on the guest list
summary.refused: Who was invited isn’t shown to your role on this event.

confirm.title_one: Send the invitation to {{count, number}} household?
confirm.title_other: Send the invitation to {{count, number}} households?
confirm.body: Each household gets one message with its own link. Sent messages can’t be recalled.
confirm.unreachable_one: {{count, number}} household has no usable address and won’t be sent anything. The guest list says why.
confirm.unreachable_other: {{count, number}} households have no usable address and won’t be sent anything. The guest list says why.

outcome.title: What happened
outcome.queued_one: On its way to {{count, number}} household. Nothing more to do.
outcome.queued_other: On its way to {{count, number}} households. Nothing more to do.
outcome.alreadySent_one: {{count, number}} household already had it, so it wasn’t sent another.
outcome.alreadySent_other: {{count, number}} households already had it, so they weren’t sent another.
outcome.suppressedHelp: They asked not to be contacted, or an earlier message to them bounced. For a bounce, correct the address on the guest list and send again. If they asked not to be contacted, talk to them.
outcome.unreachableHelp: There’s no usable address for them. Add or correct one on the guest list, then send again.
outcome.inEnglish: The reasons are in English for now.
outcome.fixOnList: Show them on the guest list
outcome.nobody: There was nobody to send to.

status.RETRYING: Being tried again after a temporary failure
status.SUPPRESSED: Not sent: they can’t be contacted

action.FAILED: Send again to try once more.
action.BOUNCED: Correct the address, then send again.
action.SUPPRESSED: They asked not to be contacted, or an earlier message bounced. Correct a bounced address and send again, or talk to them.
action.CANCELLED: Send again if they should still have it.
action.UNKNOWN: Reload the page later to see what happened.
action.UNREACHABLE: Add or correct an address, then send again.

problems.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t publish or send the invitation. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.state: That can’t be done in the invitation’s current state. The page has been reloaded.
problems.missing: This invitation is no longer available. The page has been reloaded.
problems.conflict: Someone changed the invitation just now. The page has been reloaded; try again.
problems.sendRefused: The invitation can’t be sent right now.
